note: Strike Lab V0.1 (D190): a three-frame bowling round in the Test Lab. Only the two puzzle answers are evidence (the power module, the pair of pins); aim, power, spin, rolls, pins down, strikes and retries never are.

lines.intro: Three frames in the Strike Lab. Power up the Smart Ball, hit the target pins, then bowl your way!

lines.smartWrong: That makes {total}. It needs {needed}. Try another module.

lines.targetWrong: {a} and {b} make {sum}. We need {target}. Try another pair.
